sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 10 March 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000069-P1 was put before Summit Wellness Center 069 on behalf of GSK PHARM.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 2.25 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Meningococcal minimum take of 130 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
